description: This file defines interfaces for system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime management, and metadata within the WPEFramework's Controller namespace. It contains pure virtual classes with methods for device reboot, directory deletion, plugin cloning, environment variable access, network discovery, configuration persistence, plugin lifecycle management, and status reporting.
